WITH date_2000 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
),
customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_2000 ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
ctr_avg AS (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
),
ar_customer AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           c.c_salutation,
           c.c_first_name,
           c.c_last_name,
           c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
           c.c_birth_day,
           c.c_birth_month,
           c.c_birth_year,
           c.c_birth_country,
           c.c_login,
           c.c_email_address,
           c.c_last_review_date_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state = 'AR'
)
SELECT ar_customer.c_customer_id,
       ar_customer.c_salutation,
       ar_customer.c_first_name,
       ar_customer.c_last_name,
       ar_customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       ar_customer.c_birth_day,
       ar_customer.c_birth_month,
       ar_customer.c_birth_year,
       ar_customer.c_birth_country,
       ar_customer.c_login,
       ar_customer.c_email_address,
       ar_customer.c_last_review_date_sk,
       ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN ctr_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = ctr_avg.ctr_state
JOIN ar_customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = ar_customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr_avg.ctr_avg_total_return
ORDER BY ar_customer.c_customer_id,
         ar_customer.c_salutation,
         ar_customer.c_first_name,
         ar_customer.c_last_name,
         ar_customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
         ar_customer.c_birth_day,
         ar_customer.c_birth_month,
         ar_customer.c_birth_year,
         ar_customer.c_birth_country,
         ar_customer.c_login,
         ar_customer.c_email_address,
         ar_customer.c_last_review_date_sk,
         ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
